visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Beat generic brokerage team pages: real broker names, Oregon licenses, transparent-PNG headshots, verbatim Google reviews, and a door to each /team/[slug] profile.
note: Live 2026-09-03. Index order is Breadcrumb, AboutFaces (live broker cutouts reused from about/_v3, compact H1, name door, Call and Text on the face row), V3Proof (newest four, record off — the strip of four must not sit beside a figure that says twenty-five), V3Answers (TEAM_FAQ_ITEMS as native disclosures, remaining edges in the left rail), Footer. The faces ARE the roster. A V3Ledger of the same three people was a second roster and is gone. The FAQ is no longer a Quiet prose wall. PUBLIC_UI.md opens About-family on Quiet + Sheet. The family's Sheet lives on /contact and /team/[slug]. Seller lives on Sell. Reviews: getReviews(24) newest four, TESTIMONIALS fallback when the live pool is empty. No invented quotes. KB-era deletions: KbHero, KbAbout, KbTeam, KbTestimonials, KbSell, FAQBlock, SmoothScrollProvider, KbFooter, kb-root, kb.css import.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. Home > Team. Surface tone (this page opens on cream faces, not a dark Stage). Current page never a link.

requiredComponents.name: AboutFaces
requiredComponents.section: First viewport. Same AboutFaces row as /about. Live brokers from getBrokers, canonical /images/brokers/*.png cutouts at conversation scale. Name is the door to /team/[slug]. Title, Call, and Text sit under the portrait from the live broker phone and title. No card, no wash, no rectangular box. Compact H1 lives here. No eyebrow, no card graf, no seller ask. This is the only roster on the page.

requiredComponents.name: V3Proof
requiredComponents.section: The newest four verified Google reviews, headingLevel 2, record={false} so a strip of four never sits beside a figure that says twenty-five. Door to /reviews. Same DAL read (getReviews) and the same quote shaping as /reviews.

requiredComponents.name: V3Answers
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 8, closing. The same TEAM_FAQ_ITEMS array the FAQPage JSON-LD emits, as native disclosures, with Call / reviews / about / Value my home in the left rail. Replaces the Quiet prose wall 2026-09-03: FAQ blocks as expanded paragraphs are the wall of text TASTE.md bans by name. No answer moved behind script: a closed disclosure is still in the served HTML.

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. V3_FOOTER_COLUMNS. Rendered OUTSIDE <main> so the footer maps to role=contentinfo.

perBrokerPage.note: Live 2026-09-03. Order is Breadcrumb, AboutFaces (canonical PNG cutout, Call and Text on the face row), Quiet (bio + title + Oregon license), Instrument (closed-sale figures and year chart off getBrokerSales), Atlas (every closing with a coordinate as a dot), Ledger (newest closings, photo tiles), Proof (reviews that name this broker or name no broker, record off, door to /reviews), BrokerValuationSheet (same submitBrokerSellerLead payload), Doors (call / text / email from the live phone and email). Invariants: (1) reviewBelongsOnPage filters every review. (2) getBrokerSales provides per-broker closings (both sides); fallback is getBrokerageListingTiles. (3) JSON-LD RealEstateAgent + BreadcrumbList preserved. (4) 977 zip filter on closings. (5) photo-only ledger tiles. (6) BrokerValuationSheet posts the same submitBrokerSellerLead object (variant seller, fields address / name / email / phone / timeline / notes). (7) SmsConsentDisclosure renders because the sheet collects a phone; the action does not read smsConsent. (8) Direct call/text/email from live phone/email only. (9) First viewport is AboutFaces, same cutout as /about and /team.
